description: REQ-MODEL (line 78-80) states as a settled, simple fact that 'self-funded default model must move from a pinned `glm-4.7` to ClawRouter `blockrun/auto`' and the adjacent 'Tier selection' paragraph (line 92-94) cites ONLY `runtime/loop/tier.mjs` as 'existing' ('selectTier(balanceUsdc) -> broke|lean|funded ... Broke -> free model; funded -> better model'). This omits the file that actually determines the live default at every real wake: `runtime/loop/config.mjs`. `config.mjs::DEFAULTS` (lines 47-49) hardcodes ANICCA_FREE_MODEL / ANICCA_LEAN_MODEL / ANICCA_FUNDED_MODEL all to `'free/glm-4.7'`, with a long, explicitly dated rationale comment (lines 25-46) documenting a REAL prior experiment: switching the funded tier off the free glm-4.7 model was tried (a paid/premium model), and was measured to be NET-NEGATIVE ('gpt-5.4 over ~30 min realised $0 ... burned ~$0.17 compute ... net NEGATIVE') and was deliberately REVERTED back to `free/glm-4.7`, with the comment explicitly warning 'Do NOT use `auto` (routes to PAID, drains wallet)' (line 36). `anicca-daemon.sh:74` confirms `config.mjs::loadConfig(...).ANICCA_FUNDED_MODEL` is the value actually logged/used at daemon start (i.e. config.mjs, not tier.mjs's internal constants, governs the live default — tier.mjs's own `DEFAULT_LEAN_MODEL='auto'` (tier.mjs:19-20) is dead in practice because config.mjs always supplies the ANICCA_*_MODEL keys first). Worse, the checked-in unit test `runtime/loop/__tests__/config.test.mjs:48-55` ('defaults applied when nothing set') asserts YET A THIRD, different set of defaults (ANICCA_FREE_MODEL='nvidia/deepseek-v4-flash', ANICCA_LEAN_MODEL='deepseek/deepseek-r1-0528', ANICCA_FUNDED_MODEL='openai/gpt-4o-mini') that match NEITHER config.mjs's current DEFAULTS NOR REQ-MODEL's proposed 'auto' -- meaning this test would currently FAIL against config.mjs as written. REQ-MODEL treats 'what the current default is' and 'what it should become' as a simple, already-understood two-state fact and never surfaces this three-way disagreement (config.mjs's live pinned value + its own documented burn-the-wallet postmortem vs. tier.mjs's unused 'auto' constant vs. the checked-in test's third, different expectation). A builder implementing REQ-MODEL verbatim would flip the model default back toward a paid/auto profile at the EXACT low-capital regime ($8-9 balances, per this same spec's own §0 REALITY CHECK) where config.mjs's own dated comment already recorded that exact change as a measured failure -- without ever being told that history exists, because REQ-MODEL's grounding paragraph cites only tier.mjs and never mentions config.mjs at all.

evidence.snippet: **Model-change note (REQ-MODEL):** self-funded default model must move from a pinned `glm-4.7` to ClawRouter **`blockrun/auto`** ... **Tier selection** (`runtime/loop/tier.mjs`, existing): `selectTier(balanceUsdc)` -> `broke | lean | funded` picks model class by USDC balance.

/Users/anicca/anicca/runtime/anicca-daemon.sh:74 (confirms config.mjs::loadConfig(...) is the value actually read/logged at daemon start, i.e. config.mjs -- not tier.mjs's internal constants -- governs the real default)

/Users/anicca/anicca/runtime/loop/tier.mjs:18-20 (a separate DEFAULT_LEAN_MODEL/DEFAULT_FUNDED_MODEL='auto' constant that is never actually reached in production because config.mjs always supplies the ANICCA_*_MODEL env keys first -- REQ-MODEL's 'existing' citation names only this dead-in-practice file)

/Users/anicca/anicca/runtime/loop/__tests__/config.test.mjs:48-55 (the checked-in 'defaults applied when nothing set' test expects a THIRD, different set of model defaults -- nvidia/deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek/deepseek-r1-0528, openai/gpt-4o-mini -- matching neither config.mjs's current code nor REQ-MODEL's 'auto' target, i.e. this test currently fails against config.mjs as written and the spec never surfaces this)
